log_entries: Examing an old mechanical man in Lull-Mor, I've found that with the right materials, I may be able to fix it. I'll need five Dwemer Cogs, five Dwemer Gears, and three Gold Ingots.
Though I have repaired the Watchman, it still needs to be turned on. Perhaps I can figure out a way...
The Watchman has been repaired and will now help defend Lull-Mor.

objectives.text: Find parts to repair the Watchman
Figure out how to turn on the Watchman

log_entries: Subori's husband has recruited me into a little conspiracy. Simply put, he wants me to fill a bottle of water for him. I could help him, or I could report him to Subori and see where that leads.

Subori wants me to turn the water bottle into a potion of guilt. To do so, I need to bring two snowberries, a daedra heart, and a pneuma to Medeliu Hammar, who will make the potion for me. I could always just fill the bottle with water and give it to the Skull however.

objectives.text: Fill a bottle of water, and return it to the Skull
(Optional) Tell Subori about her husband's offer
Retrieve two snowberries, a daedra heart, and a pneuma to brew a potion of guilt

log_entries: Medeliu Hammar has asked me to help fix the monitors around Lull-Mor. I never agreed, but that seems to be irrelevant. I have been giving four tools. One diagnosing machine, and three that fix the diagnosed problems. I must diagnose, then use the correct machine on the monitors around Lull-Mor to help keep things in order.
I've fixed all of Lull-Mor's monitors, time to return to Medeliu.
The monitors around Lull-Mor have been repaired.

objectives.text: Repair all the monitors around Lull-Mor

log_entries: I boarded a tram at Lull-Mor, and was greeted by its conductor, an Intelligence called the Cartwright. A bored individual, it refuses to let me pass unless I answer three riddles. If I don't, it will kill me.
The Cartwright was sufficiently amused by my riddles. I can now freely use the tram.

I have been contacted by the Eternity, the leader of the Chronographers. He has tasked me with using a teleport ball to head to Archeron's mining operation, and help shut it down. I must deactivate a boiler, and drain a reservoir, after which I should leave to let the rest of the team do their work. My reward is the freedom to loot anything in the mine that I can find. Not much of a reward, I do that anyway.
Archeron's mining project has been buried.

objectives.text: Read the Message from the Eternity
Use the teleport ball to warp to Archeron's Mines
Leave the mines by use of the teleport ball
